1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, and wherein the encoder is configured to operate in a non-transitory manner.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence, and wherein the encoder is configured to operate in a non-transitory manner.

25. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, and wherein the decoding is performed in a non-transitory manner.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, and wherein the decoding is performed in a non-transitory manner.

33. (Currently amended) A computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, and wherein the storage media is non-transitory.
